matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.lines as mlines
import numpy as np

dimensions = [
    "Reasoning",
    "Code Generation",
    "Math /\nQuantitative",
    "Language\nUnderstanding",
    "Multimodal\nUnderstanding",
    "Instruction\nFollowing",
    "Inference Speed",
    "Knowledge Recall",
]

models = [
    {"model": "GPT-4o",          "family": "GPT",    "vals": [92, 89, 85, 91, 88, 90, 42, 93]},
    {"model": "GPT-4o-mini",     "family": "GPT",    "vals": [74, 76, 68, 80, 72, 82, 78, 79]},
    {"model": "Claude 3.5 Sonnet","family": "Claude", "vals": [94, 93, 82, 93, 85, 95, 38, 90]},
    {"model": "Claude 3 Haiku",  "family": "Claude", "vals": [68, 70, 60, 76, 65, 78, 91, 72]},
    {"model": "Gemini 1.5 Pro",  "family": "Gemini", "vals": [88, 82, 72, 87, 95, 86, 45, 91]},
    {"model": "Gemini 1.5 Flash","family": "Gemini", "vals": [70, 68, 58, 75, 82, 74, 88, 74]},
    {"model": "LLaMA 3.1 405B",  "family": "LLaMA",  "vals": [86, 84, 90, 84, 45, 80, 35, 88]},
    {"model": "LLaMA 3.1 70B",   "family": "LLaMA",  "vals": [76, 74, 78, 75, 40, 72, 62, 76]},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5 72B",     "family": "Qwen",   "vals": [83, 86, 92, 82, 52, 81, 48, 85]},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5 7B",      "family": "Qwen",   "vals": [58, 62, 70, 64, 38, 60, 93, 60]},
]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
family_colors = {
    "GPT":    "#2980B9",   # blue
    "Claude": "#8E44AD",   # purple
    "Gemini": "#27AE60",   # green
    "LLaMA":  "#E67E22",   # orange
    "Qwen":   "#C0392B",   # red
}

# Top-performing models: highest average across all dims
averages = {m["model"]: np.mean(m["vals"]) for m in models}
top_threshold = sorted(averages.values())[-3]  # top 3 get extra thickness

# ── Figure setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 9), facecolor="#0F1117")
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, facecolor="#0F1117")

n_dims = len(dimensions)
x_positions = np.arange(n_dims)

# ── Draw vertical axes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for xi in x_positions:
    ax.axvline(x=xi, color="#3A3F4B", linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
    # Tick marks at 25, 50, 75, 100
    for tick in [25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ax.plot([xi - 0.04, xi + 0.04], [tick, tick],
                color="#5A6070", linewidth=0.8, zorder=2)

# ── Draw horizontal reference lines ──────────────────────────────────────────
for ref in [25, 50, 75, 100]:
    ax.axhline(y=ref, color="#2A2F3B", linewidth=0.5, linestyle="--", zorder=1, alpha=0.6)

# ── Highlight crossing zone: Reasoning (0) ↔ Inference Speed (6) ─────────────
# Subtle shaded region between these two axes
ax.axvspan(-0.25, 6.25, ymin=0.0, ymax=1.0,
           color="#FFD700", alpha=0.025, zorder=0, label="_nolegend_")
# Arrow annotation indicating the tradeoff zone
ax.annotate(
    "Reasoning ↔ Speed\ntradeoff crossing",
    xy=(3, 108), xycoords='data',
    fontsize=8.5, color="#FFD700", ha='center', fontweight='bold',
    alpha=0.85
)

# ── Draw polylines ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Draw non-top models first (behind), then top models on top
def draw_model(m, zorder_base, alpha, lw):
    color = family_colors[m["family"]]
    vals = m["vals"]
    ax.plot(x_positions, vals,
            color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
            solid_capstyle='round', solid_joinstyle='round',
            zorder=zorder_base)
    # Add model label near last axis (right side)
    ax.text(n_dims - 1 + 0.08, vals[-1], m["model"],
            fontsize=6.8, color=color, va='center', alpha=alpha * 1.1,
            fontweight='bold' if averages[m["model"]] >= top_threshold else 'normal')

# Draw lower-ranked first

        draw_model(m, zorder_base=3, alpha=0.55, lw=1.5)

# Draw top-3 with glow effect
for m in models:
    if averages[m["model"]] >= top_threshold:
        # Glow layer
        draw_model(m, zorder_base=4, alpha=0.18, lw=6)
        # Main line
        draw_model(m, zorder_base=5, alpha=0.92, lw=2.8)

# ── Highlight Multimodal (4) ↔ Math (2) divergence band ──────────────────────
# Draw subtle annotation arc between axis 2 and 4
mid_x = (2 + 4) / 2

    "Multimodal ↔ Math\ndivergent profiles",
    xy=(mid_x, 26), xycoords='data',
    fontsize=8, color="#50E3C2", ha='center', style='italic', alpha=0.8
)

# ── Axes labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for xi, label in enumerate(dimensions):
    ax.text(xi, 104, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, color="#D0D4DE", fontweight='bold',
            multialignment='center')

# ── Y-axis scale labels ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for tick in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
    ax.text(-0.35, tick, str(tick), ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=8, color="#6A7080")

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    for fam in ["GPT", "Claude", "Gemini", "LLaMA", "Qwen"]

# Add top-model indicator

    edgecolor="#3A3F4B",
    labelcolor="#D0D4DE",
    fontsize=9,
    title="Model Family",
    title_fontsize=9,

ax.set_ylim(-5, 115)
